question: Which among the following belongs to the tertiary sector of the Indian economy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Public administration**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Public administration is a crucial part of the tertiary sector, which encompasses services provided by the government to its citizens.
 
• This sector includes activities like administration of public policy, maintenance of law and order, and provision of social services.
 
• Public administration plays a pivotal role in the implementation of government policies and programs.
 
• It ensures the smooth functioning of governmental operations and the delivery of public services.
 
• Public administration is vital for maintaining the welfare and security of society, making it an integral part of the tertiary sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tertiary Sector:**

 
 
• The tertiary sector, also known as the service sector, involves the provision of services rather than goods.
 
• It includes a wide range of activities such as retail, entertainment, financial services, health care, and education.
 
• This sector is crucial for economic development and is often the largest contributor to GDP in developed countries.
 
 
 
• **Economic Sectors:**
 
 
• The economy is divided into three main sectors: primary (agriculture, forestry, fishing), secondary (manufacturing, construction), and tertiary (services).
 
• Each sector plays a unique role in the economy, contributing to overall growth and development.
 
 
 
• **Public Administration Functions:**
 
 
• Public administration involves policy formulation, implementation, and the management of public programs.
 
• It also includes activities like budgeting, human resource management, and public relations.
 
 
 
• **Role in Society:**
 
 
• Public administration ensures the effective delivery of public services such as healthcare, education, and welfare programs.
 
• It also plays a crucial role in maintaining law and order and promoting social justice.
